cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

mechanism: A makes permission to discuss the party conditional on revealing what B knows, using rank to avoid answering about personal involvement.
confusable: Ordinary evasiveness probes knowledge; this pair must turn B questions into applications A can approve or delimit.
comparison: The party alternative controls witnesses to a mishap; the keys alternative controls an account sent to a manager.
seedUse: Use D06-a party evidence and unanswered timing question, with S01 approval as the actual information-control tactic.
